examples: Starting with her success as a store manager, she steadily expanded her business and became a major entrepreneur.
Beginning with the hit of that song, they went on to branch out into every field, including commercials, movies, and musicals.
With the signal of the drum as a start, the festival procession set out.
fields.explain: Means 「それを出発点として」. It is normally used to describe something becoming active or developing dramatically from that point on. It is also sometimes used in the forms 「…をかわきりにして」 and 「…をかわきりとして」.（６４８）

fields.name: question word＋（particle）＋ともなく
examples: From somewhere or other, the lovely scent of daphne drifts over.
The next morning, the traveler left for who knows where.
Someone started clapping, and before long the hall was engulfed in a storm of applause.
The students made noise until late at night, but at some point they each went back to their rooms.
Neither of them could say who moved first, but the two ran to each other and held each other tightly.
fields.explain: Follows question words such as 「どこ、いつ、だれ、どちら」 and expresses the meaning 「どの部分かは特定はできないが」 regarding a place, time, person, thing, etc. When a particle is used, it comes directly after the question word.

examples: Even the president isn't saying that with any real prospect of success.
Even he must be ashamed of what he did by now.
Even the wedding didn't need to be done so extravagantly.
Even finding a place to live is a real struggle.
At that age, even just preparing meals must be a burden.
fields.explain: Attaches to nouns referring to people or things and expresses the meaning 「そのような人やものやことの場合も」. It is used to take one of many things as an example and comment on it. It carries the implication that the same can be said of other things as well.

fields.name: Ｎ（＋particle）すら
examples: Even a child knows something like that.
I even forgot the name of someone who helped me a long time ago.
In this cold, even the energetic Mr. Kato has caught a cold.
I hear that not only large companies but even the small factories around here have a two-day weekend.
This kind of friction exists even between parents and children who get along very well.
fields.explain: Means 「さえ」. It takes up one example and states that even that is the case, implying that the rest goes without saying. 1. means 「ふつうのひとはもちろんのこと、子供でも知っている」.

examples: Even when warning someone, you should be a little more careful with your wording.
Even if they increase our days off, we won't be able to take them if the workload stays the same.
Even if I take time off, traveling or anything like that is out of the question.
fields.explain: Expresses the meaning 「そのよう場合でも」. It implies 「そこに述べられたことがらについては一応認めるが」, and is followed by something different from what would normally be expected in such a case.
